title: OpenHands: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents
abstract: OpenHands is an open platform for AI software developers as generalist agents. It allows for the development of powerful and flexible AI agents that interact with the world in similar ways to those of a human developer. The platform features a runtime environment, an interaction mechanism, and an evaluation framework.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're a software developer, and you want to automate some tasks. You can use AI agents to interact with the world in similar ways to how you would. OpenHands is a platform that enables the development of such agents. It's like having a virtual assistant that can write code, interact with a command line, and browse the web.

With OpenHands, you can create agents that can perform complex tasks, such as developing software, navigating real-world websites, and even performing scientific research.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
OpenHands consists of three main components: agent abstraction, event stream, and runtime environment. The agent abstraction allows users to define and implement agents. The event stream tracks the history of actions and observations. The runtime environment executes actions and provides observations.

The platform also features a docker-sandboxed operating system with a bash shell, a web browser, and an IPython server that agents can interact with.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
OpenHands includes 15 established benchmarks for evaluating agents. These benchmarks cover software engineering, web browsing, and other tasks. The platform provides a systematic way to track progress in building generalist digital agents.

For example, the SWE-Bench benchmark requires agents to fix Github issues, while the HumanEvalFix benchmark requires agents to fix bugs in code.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
OpenHands has the potential to revolutionize the way we interact with software and the web. By enabling the development of powerful and flexible AI agents, we can automate complex tasks and make our lives easier.

The platform also has implications for the field of artificial intelligence, as it provides a systematic way to evaluate and improve the performance of AI agents.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
OpenHands introduces several key innovations, including a docker-sandboxed operating system and a web browser that agents can interact with. The platform also features a multi-agent delegation mechanism, which allows multiple agents to work together to solve complex tasks.

Additionally, OpenHands provides a comprehensive evaluation framework that includes 15 established benchmarks for evaluating agents.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
OpenHands is an open-source platform, and you can try it out yourself. The platform provides a user-friendly interface that allows you to interact with agents and evaluate their performance.

You can also contribute to the development of OpenHands by implementing new agents, adding new benchmarks, or improving the platform's infrastructure.
